$comment: Source manifest for SpareLink vehicle fitment images.
One entry per vehicle MODEL in the production `vehicle` table.
Every entry was matched by EXACT model, never by body style or by another
model in the same range. The vehicle database is the source of truth:
makes  = distinct vehicle.make
models = distinct (vehicle.make, vehicle.model)
Sourcing rule, in priority order:
1. official manufacturer media / press material (NOT used - see docs note)
2. official press-release imagery      (NOT used - see docs note)
3. openly licensed source permitting commercial use (THIS MANIFEST)
4. anything else                      (NOT used)
Manufacturer press photography is published 'all rights reserved' and grants
no republication licence, so priority 1 and 2 could not be satisfied for a
commercial storefront. Every image below is therefore a Creative Commons or
public-domain work fetched from Wikimedia Commons, verified at download time
by reading the file's own licence metadata. The licence is checked against
allowCommercialUse before the file is accepted; anything that fails is reported
as 'image source pending' rather than used.
standardization: background removed (u2net), trimmed to the vehicle's own
bounding box, padded to a uniform 6% of the long edge, scaled so the long edge
is 1600px, saved as WebP. Proportions are never stretched and colours are never
altered. `scripts/prepare-vehicle-fitment-images.py` performs this.
